fusions.name: Strip the Afflicted
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on a target and uses it up. Every enemy within 3 tiles takes a blow that deals 7 damage, and you regain 2 health.

fusions.name: Swarm-Borne Venom
fusions.desc: Spits a glob of venom that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Called Cloud
fusions.desc: Calls a cloud of locusts for you to feed on for 12 seconds; it strikes enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second. Each kill you make restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Gorged
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
